    var groupMembers = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
    groupMembers.addQuery('group', '2b10a3d5836a831044779cb6feaad307');
    groupMembers.query();

    //while there are more members
    while (groupMembers.next()) {

        //create a new approver record  for each member of legal
        var newApprover = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');
        newApprover.initialize();
        newApprover.setValue('document_id', current.sys_id);
		newApprover.setValue('sysapproval', current.sys_id);
        newApprover.setValue('source_table', 'x_1776078_cyber_0_regulatory_notification_task');
        newApprover.setValue('approval_reason', current.getValue('notification_type'));
        newApprover.setValue('approver', groupMembers.getValue('user'));
        newApprover.setValue('state', 'requested');
        newApprover.insert();
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-06 10:20:47</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>5ce5a31583aa831044779cb6feaad3bd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Create REG Legal approval</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_5ce5a31583aa831044779cb6feaad3bd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-06 10:34:24</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=5ce5a31583aa831044779cb6feaad3bd"/></record_update>
